fact: In December 2025 The Nation reported a pending Cybercrimes and Electronic Evidence Bill, 2024, while the in-force Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act 2016 does not name deepfakes, and MACRA's CERT head said the regulator works with platforms to remove impersonating content.
title: Mocked, Faked and Questioned: How Success Brought a Wave of Abuse for Malawi’s Scorchers
